bills.summary_ai: This Georgia bill expands the scope of practice for licensed veterinary technicians by authorizing them to administer antirabies vaccinations to animals under direct veterinary supervision, rather than requiring a veterinarian to perform this task exclusively. This delegation of duties could improve efficiency in rabies vaccination programs and make better use of the veterinary technician workforce.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians and Veterinary Technicians; licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to practice veterinary teleadvice; authorize
bills.summary_ai: This bill authorizes licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to practice veterinary teleadvice and teletriage, with veterinarians also authorized to practice telemedicine under certain circumstances. It establishes regulatory oversight by the State Board of Veterinary Medicine for these remote service delivery models.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; practice and provision of veterinary teletriage and veterinary telemedicine; revise provisions
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends Georgia law to revise provisions governing how veterinarians and veterinary technicians can practice veterinary teletriage and telemedicine services. bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine

It also clarifies which services only licensed veterinarians may perform and establishes veterinarian responsibility for all services provided by licensed paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes registration requirements for veterinary professional associates (VPAs), including obtaining certificates of registration from the state regulatory board and being listed on a public registry. It also addresses telehealth prescription authority and allows the department to rescind VPA registrations under certain conditions.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a new veterinary paraprofessional category called veterinary professional associates (VPA) by defining their role, requiring state registration through the Department of Business and Professional Regulation, and specifying their authorized scope of practice and prohibited activities. It also modifies telehealth prescription rules and creates a public registry of registered VPAs.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly regulates the veterinary technician workforce by establishing licensure requirements, defining scope of practice, setting continuing education standards, and authorizing veterinarians to delegate specific tasks to licensed technicians. categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensure for veterinarians, clarification of drug use and compounding authority, and a drug donation program. bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.

categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.

bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician workforce development by establishing alternative educational pathways and certification options for veterinary technicians. It expands flexibility in how veterinary paraprofessionals can qualify and become certified in their roles.
